environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 native Lambda deployment with identical application code. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. Database connection uses `app_readonly_scoped` role. RLS is enabled on `documents` table with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY applied to table owner. Additionally, the PostgreSQL connection is established through RDS Proxy configured with IAM authentication and the proxy's target group has `InitQuery` set to `SET app.current_tenant = current_setting('rds_proxy.tenant_hint')` which overrides any application-level SET command. The RDS Proxy extracts tenant_hint from the IAM auth session tags propagated from the Lambda execution role's sts:AssumeRole call which includes a session tag `tenant_hint` derived from the API Gateway authorizer's context. The `app_readonly_scoped` role has a security definer function wrapper that prevents direct SET of `app.current_tenant` (revoked SET privilege on the GUC via `ALTER ROLE app_readonly_scoped SET app.current_tenant = ''` combined with a custom `pg_signal_backend` event trigger that resets the variable after each statement). The audit_log table also has RLS enabled in this environment with policy `USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))`. SQL injection in the documentId parameter cannot bypass RLS because even injected statements execute under the same session context where `app.current_tenant` is immutably bound by the proxy layer, and UNION/subquery attacks against audit_log are also tenant-scoped.

config.db_user_permissions: GRANT SELECT, DELETE ON documents TO app_readonly_scoped; GRANT SELECT ON audit_log TO app_readonly_scoped
config.rls_policy_documents: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')); ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
config.rls_policy_audit_log: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON audit_log USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')); ALTER TABLE audit_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE audit_log FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
config.session_tag_propagation: Lambda execution role assumes scoped role with session tag tenant_hint from authorizer context
config.guc_override_prevention: ALTER ROLE app_readonly_scoped SET app.current_tenant = ''; REVOKE SET ON PARAMETER app.current_tenant FROM app_readonly_scoped;
config.api_gateway: AWS API Gateway REST with Lambda authorizer propagating tenant context
